$comment: Open questions, gaps, conflicts, assumptions, risks, approvals and known defects. Every open item names the evidence that would resolve it. An open 'conflict' blocks any task it lists in 'blocks'; it may never be treated as settled.

records.title: Seal manifest hashes a file that does not exist
records.statement: lib/canonical.js:104 lists 'UCOS-Zero-Hardcoding-Constitution.md' in INPUT_FILES, but the repository file is 'UCRS-Zero-Hardcoding-Constitution.md' (which lib/ucos.js:72 parses). The seal manifest records the listed file as missing, so an edit to the real UCRS constitution does not drift the seal. Pre-existing; tracked separately from the continuity work.
evidence: `npm run registry` reports 'sources 28 files' including the missing entry (observed 2026-10-22)
records.evidenceNeeded: Confirm UCRS-Zero-Hardcoding-Constitution.md is the intended input, correct INPUT_FILES, re-run `npm run registry` and `node test/registry-gate.js`.

records.title: Eleven projected artifacts share another artifact's content block
records.statement: _registry/content-map.json maps each constitution UCOS-CON-000001…010 to the same content key as a core-domain artifact (e.g. CON-000001 Constitutional Foundation and IDN-000001 Identity Architecture both → core/IDN; CON-000007 Privacy Constitution → core/AUT, the Authority Architecture block), and UCOS-CLS-000001 shares ext/SEM with UCOS-SEM-000001. The projections are 83–91% identical by word-shingle Jaccard, and some titles do not match the content they project. Pre-existing; found by context:hygiene on 2026-10-22.
records.evidenceNeeded: Owner decides whether each constitution needs its own content block in _registry/content-*.json (then re-project and audit) or whether the sharing is intended (then record that as a decision).

records.title: Continuity design decisions await owner approval
records.statement: DEC-CTX-* were made by the implementing agent on 2026-10-22 and are recorded as proposed; nothing in the repository shows the owner approving them.
records.evidenceNeeded: The owner approves, amends or rejects each DEC-CTX-* decision; record it via TASK-CTX-0002 (decision status → approved with authority and date).

records.title: The owner's master prompt is not archived
records.statement: Requirements REQ-CTX-* paraphrase the 2026-10-22 master prompt and cite it by section; its original text is not in the repository or the private store, so the paraphrases cannot be re-checked against the source.
records.evidenceNeeded: An export of the 2026-10-22 session transcript imported with `npm run context:import -- <file> --id SRC-CONV-2026-10-22-EXPORT --sensitivity private` into an access-controlled CONTEXT_ARCHIVE_DIR.

records.title: The full test suite takes ~18 minutes
records.statement: MEMORY.md reports the full `npm test` chain takes about 18 minutes and must run with a long timeout on a free port; agents that budget a short timeout will misreport results.
records.evidenceNeeded: Measured duration of `npm test` in this environment (see state fact F-003).

records.title: Status of the Postgres-cutover blockers is unknown
records.statement: The 2026-09-17 review found three runtime blockers on Postgres (untranslated INSERT OR REPLACE, INSERT OR IGNORE losing semantics, SQLite scalar MAX). README (current) describes the request-path cutover as a runbook step needing a live Postgres. Whether the blockers were fixed is not recorded.
records.evidenceNeeded: A run against a real Postgres, or code inspection of lib/sql.js translation for the three constructs.

records.title: Conversations behind sessions 2026-09-17 → 2026-10-07 are inaccessible
records.statement: Only the agents' own summaries (MEMORY.md) survive; owner directives quoted there (e.g. the 'packs' directive in session 21) cannot be checked against the original wording.
records.evidenceNeeded: Exports of those conversations, if they still exist in the originating tool, imported as private sources.

records.title: REVIEW.md findings are not mapped to their fixes
records.statement: REVIEW.md (2026-10-12) lists critical/high findings S1–S11, P1 and T1. Later commits (PR #1 'close the gaps from the full-project review', PR #2 'close the seven critical route-audit findings') suggest they were addressed, but no record maps each finding to a fix and a test, and this session did not verify them.
records.evidenceNeeded: For each finding id: the fixing commit, the test that proves it, or an explicit 'still open'.

records.title: 'Zero runtime dependencies' vs declared npm dependencies
records.statement: MEMORY.md (S0002) says the platform has zero runtime dependencies and README says the runtime drivers are dependency-free, yet package.json declares bull, ioredis and prom-client as dependencies; a grep of lib/*.js and server.js finds no require of them.
evidence: grep for require of bull/ioredis/prom-client in lib/*.js and server.js: no matches (observed 2026-10-22)
records.evidenceNeeded: Owner decides whether the three packages are vestigial (remove) or intended (correct the documentation).

records.title: Some in-scope source segments are unprocessed
records.statement: README, IMPLEMENTATION_MAP, REVIEW (2026-10-12) and parts of the repository index were archived but not every segment was read and classified during the 2026-10-22 implementation; they are counted as unprocessed, not preserved.
records.evidenceNeeded: Classify each listed segment (`npm run context:query -- unaccounted-segments`) in knowledge/coverage.json or cite it from a record.
